subject: Request: protective credit + packaging waiver for Onboardia pilot
thread_messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: protective credit + packaging waiver for Onboardia pilot

Marissa / Markus —

Quick ask: Onboardia just pushed for a pricing commitment today. They’re a high-probability pilot (product-led integration, legal green light) but their procurement timeline means we either commit to a softer package or risk losing the PoC. Evan (Onboardia) is asking for a one-time protective credit and a packaging waiver to get through the first 90 days.

High level ask (what I want sign-off for):
- Protective credit: $50k onboarding credit applied against first invoice (one-time)
- Intro discount: 30% off list for months 1–3, then revert to standard pilot price (no permanent rate change)
- Packaging waiver: allow use of 2 dedicated inference seats + burst pool for pilot (normally needs Dedicated approval)
- Term: 12 month master with 90-day elevated pilot pricing as above
- Conditions: must sign SOW by EOD Friday, DocuSign to include a three-month review clause and usage cap to protect revenue.

Why: This account is runway-critical for our health vertical proof point and will be referenced in the case study. If we stall on packaging and credit, they told us they’ll go with competitor B who front-loads credits.

Financial impact (rough):
- Expected first-year ARR contribution: $240k (post-credit)
- One-time gross revenue concession: ~$65k (credit + short-term discount)
- Contingencies: we cap total seat hours and require post-pilot review to decide expansion.

Attachments: pricing model + draft SOW + MAP attached.

Can you two authorize this as a one-off commercial exception? If yes I’ll loop in Naomi/Finance and get legal to fast-track SOW.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0127

——

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: protective credit + packaging waiver for Onboardia pilot

Ben —
Thanks for the summary. A few quick clarifying Qs before I take upward:
1) Is the $50k credit refundable or applied as a true credit against the first invoice?
2) Who owns the case study approval? We should require marketing sign-off before the credit is released.
3) What guardrails are you proposing (hard caps, SLA fallbacks, auto-revert pricing)?

Naomi / Laura — tagging finance and CFO for initial visibility. We need to ensure the credit fits the commercial authority ladder; if this exceeds my sign-off threshold I’ll escalate.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference

——

On Mon, Sep 20, 2026 at 12:18 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: protective credit + packaging waiver for Onboardia pilot

Thanks Ben — reviewed attachments quickly. A couple of notes from finance: 
- We need the credit to be one-off and netted against the first invoice (not refundable).
- Require explicit usage cap in SOW (hours and token limits) so we don't leave open-ended consumption exposure.
- We want the discount time-boxed with automatic revert clause in DocuSign.
- Need a short P&L model (what you attached is close) showing impact to quarter. Please include gross-to-net and expected revenue recognition schedule.

I can preliminarily approve up to $30k. Anything above requires CFO sign-off (Laura).

Naomi
Finance Director, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: protective credit + packaging waiver for Onboardia pilot

Appreciate the quick review Naomi — attaching updated pricing model (v2) with gross-to-net and revenue recognition worksheet. I updated the SOW to include:
- One-time credit applied against invoice #1 (non-refundable)
- Usage caps: 10,000 GPU hours for pilot; burst pool capped at 4 nodes; monthly token caps called out
- Automatic price revert clause on day 91 unless expansion signed
- Marketing case study clause: Onboardia will provide quotes only after product launch; marketing approval required before using their name in collateral

Also added a contingency clause: if they exceed cap we bill at 150% list for overage during the pilot.

Ben
(attachments: onboardia_pricing_model_v2.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_onboardia.docx)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: protective credit + packaging waiver for Onboardia pilot

Team —
I recommend approval with two hard constraints: (1) credit cap is $50k total and must be applied as Ben described; (2) the elevated packaging (dedicated seats + burst) is explicitly time-boxed to 90 days and requires a renewal trigger meeting.

Marissa — please confirm you will require the three-month review clause and an expiration clause for the packaging waiver. Naomi — if you can sign off to $50k contingent on Laura/CFO ratification, we can present this to the customer end of day Thursday.

I think the commercial upside (reference + 12mo committed term) justifies the concession.

Markus
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: protective credit + packaging waiver for Onboardia pilot

Approved (CFO sign-off):
I will approve the one-time $50k onboarding credit and the 90-day packaging waiver under the following mandatory conditions: 
1) Credit is applied to invoice #1 and treated as a one-time contra-revenue item;
2) SOW must include the usage caps and the auto-revert pricing clause Naomi outlined;
3) Legal to include a rollback trigger and an audit right for usage during the pilot;
4) Product & CS (Karthik) to deliver a post-pilot health report and a renewal recommendation within 10 business days of pilot end;
5) Marketing must sign-off on any public case study prior to credit being invoiced.

Once legal provides the updated SOW/DocuSign link incorporating these items, Ben — proceed to get signatures and route the final executed SOW to finance for close-out.

Laura Bennett
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
